_comment_toplevel: gf180_j4mmu FLASH `soc` top -- 2KB dense + pin-order floorplan variant. Binds the 2KB dense-hardened icache_2k/dcache_2k macros (FP_PIN_ORDER_CFG routes ibus/a_mmu/ctrl East toward the CPU, dbus/snpc West toward memory). Connectivity-driven macro arrangement: memory cluster (qspi->mem_region_mux->sdram) West, caches center (right-aligned, ibus-East/dbus-West), CPU East across a 300um routing channel with devices North, boot ROM far-West strap-aligned. Core-only (no pad ring). See top/README.md for routed metrics.
_comment_netlistgen: soc.v is NOT raw RTL -- it is a pre-synthesized, hierarchy-preserving generic-gate netlist (ghdl -e soc; hierarchy -top soc; blackbox <8 macro modules>; synth -top soc -flatten; write_verilog), produced by a TOP-ONLY override of the shared ghdl-yosys netlist-gen (see run.sh). The 8 macro modules (cpu/icache_adapter/dcache_adapter/bootram_infer(boot_mem_gf180)/sdram_ctrl/devices/qspi_flash_ctrl/mem_region_mux) were explicitly `blackbox`-marked BEFORE `synth -flatten`, so their internal logic/vendor-SRAM cells never got re-synthesized or flattened into the top -- only the top-level interconnect glue (aic_irq_gen, cpus' delay lanes, ddr_ram_mux's bus_mux_typec, etc, ~760 cells total) is real logic here. soc_macros_bb.v supplies `(* blackbox *)`-marked empty module declarations (matching port lists) for the 8 macros (+ the 2 leaf vendor SRAM cell types, unused at this level) so LibreLane's own Yosys.Synthesis step's hierarchy check resolves the instances without re-deriving their bodies from RTL -- LibreLane instead binds them via MACROS' lef entries below (LEF-only, no .lib -- see LEF-only-vs-.lib note in the Task 6 report; OL_TO=Magic.WriteLEF stops before any timing signoff that would need .lib).
_comment_floorplan: Approach A: cpus cluster macro (core+pure-ROM boot+onewait, 1114x1132) replaces the separate cpu+boot_mem macros -- the CPU<->boot reset-fetch bus is now INTERNAL to cpus (was a ~3.2mm cross-die route to a far-west boot macro). 7 macros (was 8). die 4497x4450=20.01mm2.
